verdict.rationale: Paddle's own hosted checkout via Paddle.js, available as an overlay that "handles all parts of the checkout process" or as an embedded inline frame, means Paddle rather than the merchant's servers collects payment details. The merchant-of-record model also places Paddle as the seller handling payments. However, no evidence explicitly mentions PCI DSS, tokenization, or a guarantee that card data never reaches merchant servers, so the scope-reduction benefit is only implied. missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS scope/compliance documentation (e.g., SAQ A eligibility), documented tokenization of card data, explicit statement that card data never touches merchant servers, independent corroboration
